_doc: Bowmaster line (spec #332, ticket B2 #334). The second class line after Hero: its job entry, its AP row and its weapon families. Skill definitions are in skills/bowmaster.json; each Bowmaster skill ticket (B7-B11) appends its own. Bowmaster has NO mobility_skill (ruling D1, spec #332): a Bowmaster owns no skill key and no quick-slot movement cell. B13 #345 enables playable; JobTree.default_job() stays 212 (survivor/jobs.json default_job).

312._starting_skill: tier C: spec #332: Arrow Blow is the starting active (slot 1) and the first skill a round learns; its WZ source is skills/bowmaster.json (book 300 -> 310 Arrow Bomb).
312._skill_pool: tier C: spec #332: the ten hand-picked Bowmaster actives from the 300/310/311/312 books (all auto-cast). Undefined keys stay inert until their tickets define them.
312._weapon_families: tier C: spec #332: bows only (WeaponInfo family bow, 145xxxx); crossbows (146xxxx) belong to Marksman. Armour and shields drop by the Bowman class bit.
312._creation_weapon: tier C: spec #332: the War Bow (reqJob 4, the Bowman bit), wearable at creation.
312._provenance: tier C: spec #332 B2 #334: the Bowmaster data line; selectable since B13 #345.
312._hub_kit: tier C: spec #332 B12 #344: the --hub / flow-driver test kit of a Bowmaster. Fixture = bowmaster_t2.json (the tier-1 bow kit); scrolls = every rate of bow ATT, gloves ATT, shoes ATT and hat DEX (scrolls.json families, 18 stacks of 10 within the Use tab); spare equipment = a hat, a second bow (1452051), gloves and a Bowman-bit top, all wearable by job 312; fallback_item = the Lv40 Composite Bow the flow driver wears at Lv1 when a round dropped no equipment.

312._ap: tier C: spec #332: the Bowman (300) row copied verbatim (the Bowman gear pattern, no new tuning); explicit so 312 no longer falls back through 310/300.

bot._card_scores: tier C: spec #332 B12 #344: explicit learn (100) and rank (74) card scores for all ten Bowmaster pool skills, the numbers BotInput's pool default gives every curated skill. Explicit so the two summons (Silver Hawk, Phoenix: kind summon, not an `attack` to the default scorer) and the nine other actives never depend on that fallback.
